offering_description.value: Owns and operates radio stations and a cable television network aimed at Black audiences, plus digital sites and apps. It sells advertising time and audience reach to brands and agencies, and it earns that revenue by broadcasting and streaming programming to listeners and viewers.

primary_products.value: radio programming; cable television network; websites and mobile apps; podcasts

primary_services.value: advertising sales; live event production; digital marketing; sponsorship campaigns

customer_segment.value: B2B: advertisers, brands, media agencies and advertising buyers; B2C: radio listeners, television viewers and digital audiences

end_markets.value: advertising; consumer goods; automotive; financial services; healthcare

revenue_model.value: advertising: advertisers pay for airtime, television spots and digital placements; other: live events, sponsorships and promotional campaigns

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs radio stations and broadcast networks, sells audience reach to advertisers; brand owner: creates and owns media brands and programming, sold to advertisers and agencies

geography_served.value: US national: radio stations concentrated in large US urban markets, with national television and digital reach

specialization.value: related lines: radio broadcasting, cable television and digital media sharing the same audience and advertisers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house advertising sales teams selling to brands and agencies; agents / brokers: media agencies that buy advertising time on behalf of clients; online: websites, apps and streaming platforms reaching digital audiences; other: over-the-air radio signals and cable carriage to viewers
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; agents / brokers; online; other

regulatory_exposure.value: high: broadcast station licenses and ownership limits set by the FCC, plus advertising rules

notes: Station count, market list and current TV network ownership may have changed; details are from my general knowledge.
